meaning: adj. 非暴力的；不訴諸武力的

meaning: adj. 無法達成的；不可企及的

The survey documented a gradation in housing quality from the waterfront to the inland districts. (這份調查記錄了住宅品質從海濱到內陸各區逐步變化的情形。)
Freedom of expression is regarded as an inalienable right in many democracies. (在許多民主國家，言論自由被視為不可剝奪的權利。)
Rectification of the billing error required refunds to thousands of customers across the region. (更正帳單錯誤後，公司必須退款給全區數千名客戶。)

meaning: adj. 表面上的；貌似如此的
example: The ostensible reason for closing the plant was modernization, though executives had already moved production abroad. (關廠表面上的理由是設備更新，但主管早已將生產移往海外。)
The state's imposition of severe nonagricultural factory piecework formats provoked heavy socio-economic disaffection among immigrant laborers. (國家強迫移民勞工接受嚴苛的非農業工廠計件制度，引發強烈的社會經濟不滿。)
The firms emphasized complementarity, combining one company’s software with the other’s distribution network. (兩家公司強調互補性，結合一方的軟體與另一方的通路網路。)

meaning: adj. 可驗證的；可證實的
example: Scientific hypotheses must be backed by verifiable data collected through rigorous and repeatable experiments. (科學假說必須有透過嚴謹且可重複實驗取得的可驗證資料支持。)

meaning: adj. 未經證實的；無根據的
example: Without clear stratigraphic fossil extractions, the theory regarding ancestral avian bipedal timelines remains unsubstantiated. (缺乏明確的地層化石證據，關於祖先鳥類雙足行走時間的理論仍未獲證實。)

meaning: vt. 撤回前言；公開否認
example: The witness recanted his earlier statement after investigators presented the authenticated correspondence. (調查人員出示經認證的通信紀錄後，證人撤回先前說法。)

meaning: n. 長篇斥責；激烈演說
example: The director delivered a harangue about loyalty after the board questioned his expense claims. (董事會質疑他的費用申報後，主管發表了一番長篇斥責。)

meaning: adj. 不具經濟效益的；不划算的
example: The review found it uneconomic to maintain the remote depot after freight volumes fell sharply. (貨運量大幅下滑後，審查認定維持偏遠貨運站不具經濟效益。)
Secularization reshaped public institutions as religious authority receded from law and education. (宗教權威逐漸退出法律與教育後，世俗化重塑了公共機構。)
The defense attorney argued that there was not even a modicum of empirical evidence connecting his client to the crime. (辯護律師主張，沒有絲毫實證能將他的當事人與該犯罪連結起來。)
The spillover from factory closures reached nearby restaurants and transport firms within weeks. (工廠關閉的外溢效應，在幾週內波及附近餐館與運輸公司。)
Opposition groups questioned the illegitimacy of a council elected without meaningful public competition. (反對團體質疑，在缺乏實質競爭下選出的議會是否正當。)
Feminist theories criticize the traditional structures of patriarchy. (女性主義理論批評父權制的傳統結構。)
The treaty required a formal renunciation of all territorial claims over the disputed border islands. (該條約要求正式放棄對有爭議邊境島嶼的所有領土主張。)
Only evidence germane to the contract dispute was admitted during the arbitration hearing. (仲裁聽證期間，只接受與合約爭端切題的證據。)

meaning: adj. 近視的；目光短淺的
example: A shortsighted person may need glasses. (近視的人可能需要眼鏡。)
The board agreed to reevaluate the merger after regulators raised concerns about market concentration. (主管機關提出市場集中疑慮後，董事會同意重新評估合併案。)
The report applies macroeconomics principles to explain how interest rate changes affect regional investment decisions. (報告運用總體經濟學原理，說明利率變化如何影響區域投資決策。)

meaning: n. 交付成果；應交付項目
example: The project contract lists every deliverable and its acceptance criteria before work begins. (專案合約在工作開始前列出所有交付成果及其驗收標準。)
The agency became trapped in a legal morass after departments issued contradictory permits. (各部門核發互相矛盾的許可後，機關陷入法律泥沼。)
Investigators sought corroboration from shipping logs before accepting the witness’s account of the disputed delivery. (調查人員先查驗航運紀錄尋求佐證，才採信證人對爭議貨運的說法。)

meaning: adj. 可犧牲的；可消耗的
example: In hierarchical military chiefdoms, common laborers were treated as expendable assets in building monumental fortifications. (在階級化的軍事酋邦中，普通勞工被當成可犧牲的人力，用來建造宏偉的防禦工事。)
The retailer entered receivership after creditors refused to extend its short-term loans. (債權人拒絕延長短期貸款後，這家零售商進入破產接管程序。)
The chair asked witnesses not to digress from the procurement decisions under review. (主席要求證人不要偏離正在審查的採購決策。)
Employees alleged favoritism after promotions repeatedly went to executives’ close associates rather than qualified staff. (升遷一再落入主管親信而非合格員工手中後，員工指控公司偏袒。)
An uncompetitive piecework system was highly disadvantageous for destitute outwork families in industrial tenements. (缺乏競爭力的計件制度，對工業區廉租住宅中的貧困家庭代工者非常不利。)

meaning: n. 不墨守成規者；特立獨行者
example: The avant-garde artist was a celebrated nonconformist who rejected traditional oil painting aesthetics. (這位前衛藝術家是著名的特立獨行者，拒絕傳統油畫美學。)

meaning: adj. 堅忍的；不動聲色的
example: The stoic medic continued treating passengers while the damaged ferry drifted toward the rocks. (受損渡輪漂向礁石時，堅忍的醫護人員仍持續救治乘客。)
The study measured connectedness among neighborhoods by tracking shared services and commuting patterns. (這項研究透過追蹤共用服務與通勤模式，衡量各社區之間的連結程度。)

meaning: n. 政治化；賦予政治色彩
example: The politicization of disaster aid weakened trust in agencies meant to serve every district. (災害援助被政治化，削弱了民眾對本應服務各區機關的信任。)

meaning: adj. 無法執行的；不可強制的
example: The court declared the agreement unenforceable because its terms violated established consumer protection laws. (法院裁定協議無法執行，因為條款違反既有消費者保護法。)

meaning: adj. 擴張主義的；擴張的
example: The militaristic imperial government pursued an aggressive expansionist policy, annexing peripheral tribal territories. (軍事化的帝國政府推行激進的擴張政策，吞併外圍部落領土。)

meaning: n. 負擔能力；價格實惠
example: The automaker's new electric vehicle model perfectly balances high performance with affordability. (這家車廠的新款電動車完美兼顧高性能與價格實惠。)
The municipal coalition led the cultural revitalization of abandoned metropolis arcades, transforming lofts into artisan shops. (地方聯盟帶頭復興廢棄大都會拱廊街的文化，並將閣樓改成工匠商店。)

meaning: adj. 無法解釋的；無責任的
example: The corporate investigator was held unaccountable for the sudden data leak incident. (企業調查員未因這次突然發生的資料外洩事件而被追究責任。)
The agency risked overreach when it attempted to regulate conduct beyond the authority granted by statute. (機關試圖管制超出法規授權範圍的行為，可能構成越權。)

meaning: adj. 雙種族的；跨種族的
example: The biracial candidate discussed how identity shaped public expectations without defining every aspect of her platform. (這位雙種族候選人談及身分如何影響公眾期待，但沒有讓它界定政見的每個面向。)

meaning: adj. 有罪責的；應受譴責的
example: The inquiry found several departments culpable for ignoring warnings that the drainage system was failing. (調查認定數個部門應為忽視排水系統失效警告負責。)
Infighting among senior officials delayed the response while residents waited for accurate information about the emergency. (高階官員內鬥延誤了應變，居民則等待有關緊急狀況的準確資訊。)

meaning: adj. 毫無根據的；無理由的
example: The company dismissed the groundless rumor but released documents to reassure employees and investors. (公司否認毫無根據的謠言，但仍公布文件安撫員工與投資人。)
It is hard to decouple tourism from environmental damage completely, since visitors inevitably consume large amounts of water and fuel. (很難讓觀光與環境破壞完全脫鉤，因為遊客無可避免會消耗大量水和燃料。)
The region's resiliency improved after officials diversified suppliers and strengthened emergency communication systems. (官員讓供應商多元化並強化緊急通訊系統後，該地區的韌性有所提升。)
The contract granted access in perpetuity, creating a dispute over whether future owners could alter the terms. (合約授予永久使用權，也引發未來所有者能否修改條款的爭議。)

meaning: n. 反文化；反主流文化
example: The counterculture challenged conventional views about work, family, and authority during a period of rapid social change. (在社會快速變遷期間，反文化挑戰了關於工作、家庭與權威的傳統觀念。)

meaning: n. 國家地位；民族建國
example: The constitution marked a turning point in nationhood by defining citizenship and the responsibilities of national institutions. (憲法界定公民身分與國家機構責任，成為建構國家地位的轉捩點。)
The court distinguished incitement from harsh criticism, protecting political debate while addressing direct calls for violence. (法院區分煽動暴力與嚴厲批評，在處理直接暴力號召時仍保障政治辯論。)
The inquiry assessed each department's culpability by examining what warnings it received and how it responded. (調查檢視各部門收到哪些警告及如何回應，以判斷其責任。)
The state's imposition of stringent permanent nonagricultural taxes sparked intense political dissension inside the chieftain confederacy council. (國家強加嚴苛的永久非農業稅，在酋邦聯盟議會內引發強烈政治分歧。)

meaning: n. 獨裁政治；專制制度
example: The constitution's authors sought safeguards against autocracy by limiting executive power and protecting independent courts. (憲法制定者限制行政權並保護獨立法院，以防止獨裁政治。)
The labor union filed a formal complaint regarding the alleged mistreatment of workers. (工會就涉嫌虐待工人提出了正式申訴。)

meaning: n. 反對主流者；逆向投資者
example: The contrarian investor bought shares during the downturn, arguing that market fears had become exaggerated. (這位逆向投資者在市場低迷時買進股票，認為市場恐慌已被誇大。)

meaning: adj. 道德嚴苛的；清教徒式的
example: The firm's puritanical expense rules barred even a modest dinner with long-standing clients. (公司道德嚴苛的報帳規定，連和老客戶吃頓簡單晚餐都不准。)
The cause of the outage remained undetermined while engineers tested several competing explanations. (工程師測試數種相互競爭的解釋期間，停電原因仍未確定。)

meaning: n. 技術官僚；專業官僚
example: The technocrat favored measurable targets, while elected officials emphasized local priorities and public accountability. (這位技術官僚偏好可量化目標，民選官員則強調地方優先事項與公共問責。)

meaning: n. 孤立主義；不干預主義
example: The debate contrasted isolationism with international engagement as lawmakers considered the country's response to a regional crisis. (立法者討論國家如何回應區域危機時，辯論將孤立主義與國際參與作比較。)

meaning: n. 菁英主義；菁英偏見
example: Critics accused the admissions process of elitism because it favored applicants from a narrow set of schools. (批評者指控招生程序具有菁英偏見，因為它偏好少數特定學校的申請者。)

meaning: n. 本土主義者；排外主義者
example: The nativist politician blamed newcomers for economic problems despite evidence pointing to broader structural causes. (儘管證據指向更廣泛的結構性原因，這位本土主義政治人物仍將經濟問題怪罪新移民。)
The militaristic centralized state utilized its garrison to subjugate peripheral tribespeople along the frontier. (軍事主義的中央集權國家利用駐軍，征服邊疆沿線的外圍部落居民。)

meaning: n. 寡頭政治；寡頭集團
example: The constitution sought to prevent oligarchy by distributing authority across elected and independent institutions. (憲法透過將權力分散至民選與獨立機構，試圖防止寡頭政治。)

meaning: n. 精疲力竭；職業倦怠
example: High turnover signaled burnout among nurses working extended shifts with insufficient staffing and limited recovery time. (人員流動率高，顯示護理師因長班、人手不足與休息時間有限而職業倦怠。)
The minister fell into disfavor after delaying a promised investigation into contracting practices. (部長延宕調查承包作業的承諾後，逐漸失去支持。)
The indeterminacy of the evidence prevented investigators from identifying a single cause of the accident. (證據的不確定性使調查人員無法認定事故的單一原因。)

meaning: adj. 不合理的；不健全的
example: The auditor rejected the estimate as unsound because it relied on outdated prices and unsupported assumptions. (稽核員認為估算不合理，因為它依賴過時價格與缺乏根據的假設。)

meaning: adj. 弱勢的；資源不足的
example: The clinic extended its evening hours so underprivileged workers could see a doctor without losing wages. (診所延長夜間門診，讓弱勢勞工看病不必損失工資。)

meaning: n. 緊急情況；迫切需求
example: The exigency of the flood response required officials to redirect staff from routine services to rescue operations. (洪水應變的迫切需求，要求官員將人力從例行服務調往救援工作。)

meaning: adj. 站不住腳的；不可辯護的
example: The agency's refusal to publish the findings became indefensible once independent experts confirmed their accuracy. (獨立專家確認結果準確後，機關拒絕公布研究發現便站不住腳。)
The clinic's caseload doubled, forcing administrators to hire staff and extend appointment hours. (診所個案量增加一倍，迫使行政人員增聘員工並延長看診時段。)
The United States Congress is a bicameral legislature consisting of two houses. (美國國會是由兩院組成的兩院制立法機構。)
Managers were complicit in concealing safety problems because they had received warnings and chose not to act. (經理們收到警告卻選擇不處理，因此共同參與隱瞞安全問題。)

meaning: n. 無所不在；普遍存在
example: The ubiquity of mobile payments changed consumer expectations, even in regions with limited banking access. (行動支付無所不在，改變了消費者期待，即使在銀行服務有限的地區也是如此。)
The glaring incongruity between the politician's lavish lifestyle and his public rhetoric alienated working-class voters. (這名政治人物奢侈的生活方式與公開言論明顯不一致，疏遠了勞工階層選民。)

meaning: adj. 再度興起的；復甦的
example: Resurgent inflation forced central bankers to reconsider plans for gradual interest rate reductions. (通膨再度升溫，迫使央行官員重新考慮逐步降息的計畫。)
The witness continued to aver that she had reported the safety hazard before the accident occurred. (證人持續斷言，事故發生前她就已通報安全危害。)

meaning: n. 危言聳聽者；杞人憂天者
example: Officials dismissed the analyst as an alarmist until later data confirmed the risks she had identified. (官員起初斥責分析師危言聳聽，直到後續數據證實她指出的風險。)

meaning: n. 重新詮釋；重新解讀
example: The director's modern reinterpretation of the classic Shakespearean tragedy received rave theatrical reviews. (導演對莎士比亞經典悲劇的現代重新詮釋，獲得劇評高度讚賞。)

meaning: n. 任人唯親；裙帶關係
example: The audit uncovered nepotism in hiring, with several senior officials placing relatives in newly created positions. (稽核揭露招聘任人唯親，多名高階官員將親屬安插在新設職位。)
The group took a hardline position. (那個團體採取強硬立場。)
The market pullback provided an opportune moment for the firm to buy back its shares. (市場回檔為該公司回購股票提供了良機。)

meaning: v. 輕視；使顯得不重要
example: We should not trivialize the emotional impact of bullying on children. (我們不應該輕視霸凌對兒童造成的心理影響。)
The study emphasized the interdependency of food prices, transportation costs, and household income in the region. (研究強調當地食品價格、運輸成本與家庭收入之間的相互依存關係。)
Readers may misconstrue the finding if the article omits important limits on the study's sample. (如果文章省略研究樣本的重要限制，讀者可能會曲解研究結果。)

meaning: adj. 別有用心的；隱藏的
example: He offered to help, but I suspected he had an ulterior motive. (他主動要幫忙，但我懷疑他有不可告人的動機。)

meaning: adj. 蒙恩惠的；受制於人的
example: The regulator insisted it was not beholden to the industries whose practices it was responsible for overseeing. (監管機關堅稱自己不受其負責監督的產業左右。)

meaning: adj. 隕石的；流星的；疾速的
example: Geologists discovered a crater that preserves evidence of a catastrophic meteoric impact at the Cretaceous boundary. (地質學家發現了一個隕石坑，保存了白堊紀邊界發生毀滅性隕石撞擊的證據。)

meaning: adj. 未獲承認的；未被察覺的
example: The report highlighted unacknowledged contributions from temporary staff who had completed much of the fieldwork. (報告凸顯臨時員工未獲承認的貢獻，他們其實完成了大部分實地工作。)

meaning: adj. 近視的；目光短淺的
example: The government's short-term focus was criticized as a myopic economic policy. (政府對短期利益的關注被批評為目光短淺的經濟政策。)
The court focused on the illegality of the search rather than the seriousness of the evidence it uncovered. (法院著重審查搜索是否違法，而非它所發現證據的嚴重性。)
Implementation required concurrence from local officials, national regulators, and the project's independent oversight board. (計畫執行需要地方官員、國家監管者與獨立監督委員會一致同意。)
The campaign warned that economic anxiety could fuel xenophobia and hostility toward newcomers. (這項活動警告，經濟焦慮可能助長排外心理與對新移民的敵意。)

meaning: adj. 不合情理的；過分的
example: The court ruled that the contract's unconscionable fees exploited customers who had few alternatives. (法院裁定合約中不合理的費用剝削了選擇有限的顧客。)
The system's modularity allowed engineers to upgrade individual components without replacing the entire platform. (系統的模組化讓工程師能升級個別組件，不必更換整個平台。)
The proposal permitted expropriation of land for public works, provided owners received timely and fair compensation. (提案允許為公共工程徵收土地，但須及時且公平補償地主。)

meaning: adj. 值得稱讚的；可嘉的
example: The team's performance throughout the year was highly creditable, especially considering the challenging market conditions. (考量到艱困的市場環境，團隊全年表現尤其值得稱讚。)

meaning: adj. 說教的；道德主義的
example: The reviewer found the documentary moralistic because it condemned individual choices without examining structural pressures. (評論者認為紀錄片說教味濃厚，因為它譴責個人選擇，卻不檢視結構性壓力。)

meaning: n. 社團主義；企業主義
example: The historian described corporatism as a system where organized interests negotiate directly with the state. (歷史學家將社團主義描述為組織化利益團體直接與國家協商的制度。)
The bank began accepting nontraditional credit data, such as rent records, from applicants without loan histories. (銀行開始接受沒有貸款紀錄的申請人提供房租紀錄等非傳統信用資料。)

meaning: adj. 可追溯的；可查明的
example: Every payment was traceable to a documented invoice, allowing auditors to verify the project's expenditures. (每筆付款都能追溯至有文件佐證的發票，讓稽核員得以核實計畫支出。)
The country adopted a unicameral legislature to simplify lawmaking and reduce conflict between parliamentary chambers. (該國採行一院制，以簡化立法並減少議會兩院之間的衝突。)

meaning: v. 排斥；流放；逐出（社群）
example: Egalitarian tribes would collectively ostracize any individual leader who attempted to monopolize foodstuff resources or hoard weapons. (平等主義部落會集體排斥任何企圖壟斷食物資源或囤積武器的領袖。)
Ruinous borrowing left the municipality unable to maintain essential services after interest rates rose. (借貸過度造成重大損失，利率上升後市府無力維持基本服務。)
The workshop encouraged ideation before participants evaluated the feasibility of each proposed solution. (工作坊鼓勵與會者先構思，再評估每項解決方案的可行性。)
The review documented misogyny in workplace policies that penalized mothers more heavily than comparable male employees. (評估記錄職場政策中的厭女現象，母親受到的懲罰比條件相當的男性員工更重。)

meaning: adj. 無懈可擊的；不可動搖的

meaning: adj. 基礎建設的；基礎設施的

meaning: n. 指數化；按指數調整

meaning: n. 小額金融；微型金融

meaning: n. 和平主義；反戰主義

meaning: adj. 無法反駁的；確鑿的

meaning: n. 重新估值；重新評價；幣值重估

The defendant filed a counterclaim, arguing that the supplier had breached the agreement first. (被告提出反訴，主張供應商先違反協議。)

meaning: adj. 可檢驗的；可測試的

meaning: adj. 可再現的；可重複的

meaning: adj. 還原論的；過度簡化的
example: The article offered a reductionist account of poverty by attributing complex outcomes to individual choices alone. (文章把複雜結果全歸因於個人選擇，對貧窮提出過度簡化的解釋。)

meaning: adj. 不適用的；不相關的

meaning: n. 壟斷者；獨占企業；壟斷市場的公司

meaning: adj. 截然相反的；對立的

meaning: vt. 阻撓；拒絕提供資訊

meaning: n. 土地持有；土地所有權

meaning: n. 虛無主義；否定一切

meaning: n. 暫時休假；停薪留職

meaning: n. 強硬手段；不妥協做法

meaning: n. 盲目崇拜；偶像崇拜

meaning: adj. 享樂主義的；縱欲的

The investigation exposed the executive's duplicity, as he publicly denied a plan he had privately approved. (調查揭露主管口是心非，他私下批准計畫，公開時卻予以否認。)

meaning: adj. 無法辯解的；不合理的

meaning: n. 最低點；最低谷；最糟時刻

meaning: adj. 無階級的；不分階級的

meaning: adj. 站得住腳的；可維持的

meaning: adj. 不受限制的；自由的

meaning: adj. 未交代的；未計入的

meaning: vt. 預先判斷；偏見定論

meaning: adj. 可解釋的；可理解的

meaning: adj. 易處理的；易控制的

meaning: adj. 無可爭辯的；確鑿的

meaning: n. 專制主義；絕對主義

meaning: n. 投機商；牟取暴利者

The analyst tested the directionality of the relationship between public spending and regional employment. (分析師檢驗公共支出與區域就業之間關係的方向性。)

meaning:

The supreme court ruled to desegregate public schools across the country. (最高法院裁定廢除全國公立學校的種族隔離。)

meaning:
n. 殖民主義者；殖民者
adj. 殖民主義的；殖民地的
example: The historian challenged the colonialist account that portrayed local resistance as disorder rather than political opposition. (歷史學家挑戰殖民主義敘事，指出它把地方抵抗描寫成混亂，而非政治反抗。)

meaning: adv. 工業上；以工業方式
example: The valley developed industrially after the railway connected its mines with the country's largest port. (鐵路連接礦區與全國最大港口後，這座山谷開始發展工業。)
The tribunal documented the inhumanity of forced relocations carried out against civilians during the conflict. (法庭記錄了衝突期間對平民強制遷移的殘暴行徑。)

meaning:
n. 右翼人士；右派
adj. 右翼的；右派的
example: The rightist bloc opposed the proposed labor protections, calling them an unnecessary burden on employers. (右翼陣營反對勞工保障法案，稱其會對雇主造成不必要的負擔。)
The columnist warned that leaders overdraw the threat to justify costly measures with little public oversight. (專欄作家警告，領袖誇大威脅，藉此合理化缺乏公眾監督的高成本措施。)
The military historian analyzed the brilliant stratagem employed by the general to outmaneuver the opposing forces. (軍事歷史學家分析了將軍用以勝過敵對部隊的精妙計謀。)

meaning: n. 關鍵人物；核心要素
example: The regional rail link became the linchpin of the mayor's plan to revive declining commercial districts. (區域鐵路連線成了市長振興衰退商圈計畫的核心。)

meaning: n. 多邊主義；多國合作
example: The foreign minister defended multilateralism as the best response to cross-border climate and security threats. (外交部長捍衛多邊主義，認為這是因應跨境氣候與安全威脅的最佳方式。)
Polynesians' success in navigating the ocean showed exceptional resourcefulness built on knowledge of the stars. (玻里尼西亞人航海的成就，展現出以星象知識為基礎的卓越機智。)

meaning: adj. 跨宗教的；宗教間的
example: The interfaith council organized a joint relief effort after floods damaged homes across several neighborhoods. (洪水損壞數個社區的住宅後，跨宗教委員會共同發起救援行動。)

meaning: n. 分配；分攤；（席位）撥給
example: The constitutional amendment established a strict system for the fair apportionment of legislative seats based on population. (憲法修正案確立了一個嚴格的制度，以便根據人口公平分配立法席位。)
Reliable public transit undergirds the city's strategy for reducing congestion and expanding access to jobs. (可靠的大眾運輸支撐著市府減少壅塞、擴大就業機會的策略。)

meaning: n. 可轉移性；可轉讓性
example: The contract limits transferability of shares until the founding investors have recovered their initial capital. (合約限制股份轉讓，直到創始投資人收回初始資本為止。)

The waterfront's rejuvenation followed years of investment in public spaces, transit, and affordable housing. (多年投資公共空間、大眾運輸與平價住宅後，濱水區逐漸復甦。)

meaning: n. 志願服務；志願主義
example: The report credits volunteerism with sustaining neighborhood clinics during the prolonged public health emergency. (報告肯定志願服務在長期公共衛生緊急狀態期間維持了社區診所運作。)

meaning:
n. 千禧世代；千禧年論者

The reclassification of temporary staff as employees entitled hundreds of workers to health benefits. (臨時人員重新列為正式員工後，數百名勞工取得了健康福利。)

meaning: adj. 不受妨礙的；無負擔的

The constitution preserved monarchical symbolism while transferring executive authority to an elected parliament. (憲法保留君主制象徵，同時將行政權移交給民選國會。)

meaning:
adj. 專制主義的；絕對的
n. 專制主義者；絕對論者
example: The historian contrasts the ruler's absolutist vision with provincial leaders who defended local assemblies. (歷史學家將統治者的專制主義願景，與捍衛地方議會的省級領袖作對比。)

meaning: adv. 意味深長地；顯然地
example: Tellingly, the company's revised forecast omitted the market segment that had generated its fastest growth. (耐人尋味的是，公司修訂預測時，省略了成長最快的市場區塊。)
The researchers questioned the survey's representativeness because rural households were undercounted in the final sample. (研究人員質疑調查的代表性，因為最終樣本中的農村家庭數目偏低。)

meaning: n. 可兌換性；可轉換性
example: The central bank suspended currency convertibility after foreign reserves fell below the statutory threshold. (外匯存底低於法定門檻後，央行暫停了貨幣兌換。)
The publisher removed the defamatory passage after lawyers warned that it falsely accused a local business owner. (律師警告內容誣指當地企業主後，出版社刪除了誹謗段落。)

meaning: adv. 毀滅性地；極具衝擊地
example: The court ruled devastatingly against the company, invalidating its core patents and ordering substantial damages. (法院作出對公司極為不利的裁決，撤銷核心專利並判處鉅額賠償。)

meaning: n. 聲勢漸長；民意浪潮
example: A groundswell of opposition forced the council to reopen hearings on the proposed highway through wetlands. (反對聲浪逐漸擴大，迫使議會重啟對穿越濕地公路計畫的聽證。)

meaning: adj. 技術官僚的；專家治國的
example: Critics said the technocratic reform ignored residents' priorities by relying solely on efficiency metrics. (批評者認為，這項技術官僚式改革只依賴效率指標，忽略居民的優先需求。)
The professionalization of emergency response improved coordination but raised costs for smaller municipalities. (緊急應變的專業化改善了協調，也增加小型自治體的成本。)

meaning: n. 重新定位；重新調整方向
example: A reorientation toward preventive care reduced emergency visits and improved outcomes for rural patients. (轉向預防照護後，急診就醫減少，偏鄉病患的治療成果也改善。)

meaning: n. 拒絕妥協者；堅持不從者
example: One holdout delayed the land deal, demanding stronger relocation guarantees for the neighborhood's elderly residents. (一名拒絕妥協者延宕土地交易，要求為社區長者提供更完善的遷置保障。)

meaning: adj. 宿命論的；聽天由命的
example: The report rejected a fatalistic view of factory closures, documenting policy choices that could preserve local employment. (報告反駁工廠關閉只能聽天由命的看法，並記錄了可保留地方就業的政策選擇。)

meaning: n. 自由意志主義；自由放任主義
example: The debate contrasted libertarianism's emphasis on individual choice with arguments for stronger public regulation. (辯論對比自由意志主義強調個人選擇，與支持加強公共管制的論點。)

meaning:
vi. 舉止；表現
vt. 使一致；使相符

meaning: adj. 種族滅絕的；滅絕族群的

Public trust became the keystone of the reform effort, enabling officials to introduce difficult changes. (公眾信任成為改革工作的基石，使官員得以推動艱難變革。)
Critics challenged the arbitrariness of a rule that imposed different penalties on otherwise similar cases. (批評者質疑一項規定的武斷性，因為它對相似案件施以不同處罰。)
The manager's parsimony saved money initially, but chronic understaffing eventually damaged customer service. (經理起初靠節省開支省下了錢，但長期人手不足最終損害了顧客服務。)
Her unfamiliarity with local customs caused minor misunderstandings during the first weeks abroad. (她不熟悉當地習俗，因此在海外的頭幾週出現一些小誤會。)
The treaty prohibited the infliction of collective punishment on civilians for actions by armed groups. (條約禁止因武裝團體的行動而對平民施加集體懲罰。)

The new administration retained one holdover from the previous cabinet to preserve institutional knowledge. (新政府留任前內閣的一名成員，以保留制度運作的經驗。)

meaning: adj. 可證明的；可證實的

The report attributed the region's economic backwardness partly to decades of limited investment in infrastructure. (報告將該地區的經濟落後，部分歸因於數十年來基礎建設投資不足。)
The committee lost valuable time debating each triviality instead of deciding how to address the urgent housing shortage. (委員會耗費寶貴時間爭論每件瑣事，沒有決定如何處理迫切的住房短缺。)
Critics dismissed the novel as escapist because it ignored the economic hardships shaping its characters' lives. (評論者認為這部小說逃避現實，因為它忽略了塑造角色生活的經濟困境。)

meaning: vt. 重新估價；重新評估

The minister called the market's sharp decline an overreaction to a temporary delay in the trade negotiations. (部長稱市場大幅下跌，是對貿易談判暫時延誤的過度反應。)

Patients praised the nurse's attentiveness, noting that she caught a dosage error the pharmacy had missed. (病患稱讚這位護理師十分留心，指出她發現了藥局漏看的劑量錯誤。)
The autocrat centralized decision making and punished officials who questioned his authority. (這位獨裁者集中了決策權，並懲罰質疑他權威的官員。)
The steadiness of the market is a good sign for long-term investors. (市場的穩定性對長期投資人而言是個好兆頭。)

meaning: n. 憲政主義；立憲制度
example: Constitutionalism limits government authority by requiring leaders to obey established legal rules. (憲政主義透過要求領導者遵守既定法律，限制政府權力。)

meaning: vt. 花費超過；支出多於
example: The incumbent planned to outspend her challenger on advertising, hoping to dominate the final weeks of the campaign. (現任者計畫在廣告支出上超過對手，希望主導競選最後幾週。)
The court held the case in abeyance until both parties submitted the missing financial documents. (法院暫緩審理此案，直到雙方提交缺漏的財務文件。)
The municipal government decided to expropriate private land along the riverbank to construct a public highway. (市政府決定徵收沿河岸的私人土地，以建造一條公共公路。)
Recessionary conditions reduced tax revenue and forced the city to postpone several planned infrastructure projects. (經濟衰退使稅收減少，迫使市府延後數項基礎建設計畫。)

The stringency of the new standards surprised manufacturers, who had expected a longer transition period. (新標準的嚴格程度讓製造商驚訝，他們原本預期過渡期會更長。)
The entrenchment of outdated procedures slowed reform even after senior leaders publicly endorsed modernization. (即使高層公開支持現代化，過時程序根深蒂固仍拖慢改革。)
Analysts should not dichotomize the issue into public and private interests when both groups share costs. (當公私部門共同承擔成本時，分析者不應將議題簡化成兩種利益。)
The researcher reasoned inductively from several observations before proposing a general explanation for the trend. (研究者先從多項觀察歸納推理，才提出解釋整體趨勢的一般說法。)

meaning: n. 供過於求；供應過剩
example: An oversupply of apartments pushed rents downward, although many low income families still could not afford them. (公寓供應過剩使租金下跌，但許多低收入家庭仍然負擔不起。)

meaning: adj. 煽動叛亂的；煽動性的
example: Authorities accused the publisher of distributing seditious material, though the court later dismissed the charge. (當局指控出版商散布煽動叛亂的材料，但法院後來撤銷了指控。)
A miscommunication about the deadline caused two departments to submit incompatible versions of the same proposal. (截止日期溝通失誤，導致兩個部門提交了互不相容的同一提案版本。)

meaning: adj. 不置可否的；含糊的
example: The spokesperson remained noncommittal about the merger, refusing to confirm whether negotiations had actually begun. (發言人對合併案不置可否，拒絕證實談判是否已經開始。)

meaning: n. 一批；分期款項；債券分層
example: The lender released the next tranche of construction funding after inspectors verified progress at the manufacturing site. (檢查人員確認製造場址的工程進度後，貸款機構才撥出下一期建設資金。)
The investigation found falsification of sales records designed to conceal losses before the company sought new financing. (調查發現公司在尋求新融資前，偽造銷售紀錄以掩蓋虧損。)

meaning: n. 煽情主義、譁眾取寵

The curtailment of public transit after midnight left hospital workers with few safe ways home. (午夜後大眾運輸縮減，讓醫院員工幾乎沒有安全的返家方式。)

meaning: adj. 信用良好的；值得授信的
example: The bank considered the manufacturer creditworthy after reviewing its cash flow and long term contracts. (檢視現金流與長期合約後，銀行認為這家製造商信用良好。)

meaning: vt. 囤貨過多；存貨過剩
example: Retailers sometimes overstock seasonal goods when forecasts overestimate demand, leaving warehouses full after the holiday rush. (零售商有時會囤積過多季節商品，因為預測高估需求，假期過後倉庫仍堆滿貨物。)

meaning: adj. 通貨緊縮的；壓低價格的
example: Weak consumer spending created deflationary pressure that complicated the central bank's recovery strategy. (消費支出疲弱形成通貨緊縮壓力，使央行的復甦策略更加複雜。)
The candidate's xenophobic rhetoric alarmed business leaders whose firms relied on international workers. (候選人的仇外言論讓仰賴國際勞工的企業領袖感到不安。)

meaning: adj. 集體主義的；重視集體的
example: The reform challenged collectivist traditions by allowing rural cooperatives to manage their own land revenues. (這項改革挑戰集體主義傳統，允許農村合作社自行管理土地收益。)

meaning: n. 集體主義；集體所有制
example: The historian compared collectivism under wartime planning with the market reforms that followed the conflict. (歷史學家比較戰時計畫經濟下的集體主義，以及戰後推行的市場改革。)
The proposed rollback of emissions rules drew opposition from manufacturers that had already upgraded their plants. (已完成設備升級的製造商反對撤銷排放規範的提案。)

meaning: n. 制式條款；套用文字

meaning: n. 重新武裝；擴充軍備

meaning: n. 管理失當；行政失職

meaning: adj. 享樂的；以快樂為導向的

Investors praised the chief's decisiveness when she closed unprofitable branches before losses deepened. (執行長在虧損擴大前關閉不賺錢的分店，投資人稱讚她果斷。)

meaning: n. 現任身分；在任期間

meaning: adj. 資源配置的；分配上的

meaning: n. 任人唯親；裙帶關係

meaning: n. 生產過剩；過量生產

meaning: adj. 無法預見的；難以預料的

meaning: n. 抵押人；抵押借款人

meaning: n. 失職；不當執行職務

meaning: n. 浪費公帑的計畫；無效工程

meaning: adj. 就業不足的；未充分就業的

meaning: vt. 證券化；轉為可交易證券

meaning: n. 全球主義；全球化思維

meaning: adj. 非競爭性的；缺乏競爭的

meaning: adj. 不可行的；難以實行的

The divestment of the coal division helped the conglomerate meet its climate targets and reassure investors. (出售煤炭部門協助這家企業集團達成氣候目標，也讓投資人安心。)

meaning: adj. 任人唯賢的；依績效選拔的

meaning: n. 損益兩平；收支平衡點

meaning: adj. 缺乏彈性的；反應遲鈍的

meaning: adj. 可複製的；可重現的

meaning: adj. 無風險的；不承擔風險的

meaning: v. 重新評估；重新估價

meaning: n. 排定優先順序；優先處理

meaning: n. 可否認性；推諉空間

meaning: adj. 採掘的；資源榨取型的
example: The report warns that extractive industries can leave local communities with pollution after profits move abroad. (報告警告，資源採掘產業可能在獲利流向海外後，讓當地社區承受污染。)

meaning: n. 小額信貸；微型貸款

meaning: n. 賦予公民權；取得選舉權

meaning: n. 邊緣政策；冒險對峙

meaning: adj. 有報酬的；收益豐厚的

meaning: vt. 未充分利用；使用不足

meaning: adj. 反歧視的；禁止歧視的

meaning: n. 部落主義；群體偏私

meaning: n. 緊張緩和；關係解凍

meaning: n. 現實政治；權力政治

meaning: adj. 非貨幣的；非金錢的

meaning: vt. 使商品化；使同質化

meaning: n. 轉口港；貨物集散地

meaning: n. 群體迷思；從眾思維

meaning: n. 證券化；資產證券化

The regulator closed a loophole that enabled circumvention of disclosure rules through offshore subsidiaries. (主管機關堵住一項漏洞，避免企業透過海外子公司規避揭露規定。)

meaning: n. 就業不足；未充分就業

The campaign's demonization of migrants obscured evidence that newcomers were reviving several declining neighborhoods. (競選活動妖魔化移民，掩蓋了新移民正帶動幾個衰退社區復甦的證據。)
Executives treated the obsolete warehouse as deadweight, though its location still offered valuable access to the port. (高階主管把老舊倉庫視為累贅，儘管它的地點仍能提供通往港口的重要管道。)

meaning: n. 證券交易所；證券市場

meaning: n. 錯誤配置；不當分配

The report questioned subsidization of commuter rail, comparing its costs with access improvements in rural counties. (報告質疑對通勤鐵路的補貼，並將其成本與改善偏遠郡交通的效益比較。)
The treaty's legitimization of the new border angered residents whose villages had been divided without consultation. (條約使新邊界獲得正當化，惹怒了那些村莊未經協商就遭到分割的居民。)

meaning: n. 雙頭壟斷；兩家寡占
example: The airline duopoly kept fares high until a low cost carrier entered the regional market. (在低成本航空公司進入區域市場前，兩家航空公司的寡占讓票價居高不下。)

meaning: adj. 無法收回的；難以催收的
example: The lender wrote off several uncollectible loans after borrowers closed their businesses and disappeared. (借款人關閉企業並失聯後，貸方將幾筆無法收回的貸款列為呆帳。)
The commission studied decriminalization of possession while retaining penalties for large scale trafficking. (委員會研究持有行為除罪化，同時保留對大規模販運的刑罰。)

meaning: n. 不成比例；比例失衡
example: The audit found a disproportion between executive bonuses and wage growth among frontline employees. (稽核發現，高階主管獎金與第一線員工薪資成長之間比例失衡。)

meaning: v. 不公劃分選區；操弄選區
example: Lawmakers tried to gerrymander the districts, but the state court ordered an independent map. (立法者試圖不公劃分選區，但州法院下令改由獨立機構繪製選區圖。)

meaning: adj. 寡占市場的；少數企業壟斷的
example: In an oligopolistic market, three suppliers can influence prices without openly coordinating their decisions. (在寡占市場中，三家供應商即使沒有公開協調，也能影響價格。)

meaning: v. 按比例分攤；按比例計算
example: The insurer agreed to prorate the refund according to the months remaining on the customer's policy. (保險公司同意依照保單剩餘月份按比例退還保費。)
The city is trying to increase the ridership of public transportation. (市府正試圖增加大眾運輸的乘客人數。)

meaning: v. 過度建設；建造過多
example: Developers continued to overbuild luxury apartments even as vacancy rates climbed across the city's central districts. (即使市中心空屋率攀升，建商仍持續過度興建豪華公寓。)

meaning: adj. 可撤銷的；可廢止的
example: The license is revocable if the operator repeatedly ignores safety rules or conceals reported accidents. (若業者屢次無視安全規則或隱瞞事故通報，執照可被撤銷。)

meaning: vt. 重新國有化；收歸國營
example: The new government may renationalize the rail operator if private owners fail to meet service guarantees. (若民營業主未達服務保證，新政府可能將鐵路營運商重新收歸國營。)

meaning: adj. 無法量化的；難以估算的
example: The merger's unquantifiable reputational damage mattered more to executives than its immediate accounting costs. (這次合併難以量化的聲譽損害，比眼前的會計成本更令主管在意。)

meaning: vt. 剝奪公民權；取消選舉權
example: The court ruled that the proposed identification law would disfranchise thousands of eligible voters in remote counties. (法院裁定，擬議中的身分證明法將剝奪偏遠郡數千名合資格選民的投票權。)

meaning: n. 提供擔保；抵押設定
example: The lender tightened collateralization requirements after falling property values weakened several regional banks. (房價下跌削弱數家地區銀行後，放款機構收緊了擔保要求。)
Analysts warned that persistent overvaluation in commercial real estate could expose lenders to sudden losses. (分析師警告，商用不動產持續估值過高，可能讓放款機構面臨突發損失。)

meaning: vi. 降低槓桿；減少負債
example: The retailer plans to deleverage by selling surplus warehouses and directing proceeds toward its most expensive loans. (零售商計畫出售多餘倉庫來降低槓桿，並把所得用於償還利率最高的貸款。)

meaning: vt. 解除管制；放寬管制
example: The ministry moved to decontrol fuel prices gradually, hoping to reduce shortages without provoking a sudden inflation shock. (部會著手逐步解除燃料價格管制，希望減少短缺，又避免引發通膨衝擊。)

meaning: adj. 可替代的；能互換的
example: The buyer assumed the components were substitutable, but testing revealed costly differences in durability. (買方原以為零件可以互換，測試卻發現耐用度差異會增加成本。)

meaning: adj. 聲譽上的；名聲相關的
example: A reputational crisis can erase years of customer loyalty even when regulators impose only modest penalties. (即使主管機關只處以輕微罰款，聲譽危機仍可能抹去多年累積的顧客忠誠。)

meaning: n. 總體經濟；整體經濟
example: Executives delayed expansion because weak household spending threatened the macroeconomy more broadly. (家庭支出疲弱可能拖累整體經濟，因此主管延後擴張計畫。)

meaning: adj. 反壟斷的；限制壟斷的
example: Antimonopoly rules forced the platform to open its payment network to competing regional providers. (反壟斷規範迫使平台向其他區域業者開放支付網路。)
The committee suspected undervaluation after comparable firms sold for substantially higher prices. (可比公司以高出許多的價格出售後，委員會懷疑這家公司遭到低估。)
Disinvestment in maintenance saved cash briefly but left the transit network vulnerable to costly failures. (縮減維修投資短期內省下現金，卻讓運輸網容易發生昂貴故障。)

meaning: n. 過度消費；消耗過量
example: The study links overconsumption of water to pricing policies that reward heavy users during droughts. (研究指出，水資源過度消費與乾旱時獎勵大量用水者的定價政策有關。)

meaning: n. 反猶太主義；反猶偏見
example: The museum expanded its exhibit to explain how antisemitism shaped public policy across generations. (博物館擴充展覽，說明反猶太主義如何影響數代人的公共政策。)

meaning: adj. 客製化的；量身打造的
example: The bank commissioned bespoke software to combine local lending rules with its regional risk controls. (銀行委託開發客製化軟體，整合地方放款規則與區域風險控管。)

meaning:
n. 中間派人士；中間派
adj. 中間派的；中間路線的
example: The centrist senator backed a compromise budget after negotiators restored funding for rural hospitals. (談判代表恢復偏鄉醫院經費後，這位中間派參議員支持折衷預算。)
The board reviewed her credentials in public health before appointing her to lead the emergency response office. (董事會審查她在公共衛生領域的資歷後，任命她領導緊急應變辦公室。)
Critics argued that criminalization would deter patients from seeking treatment and push suppliers underground. (批評者認為，刑事化會讓病患不敢求醫，並把供應商逼入地下。)

meaning: n. 群眾募資；群眾集資
example: The museum used crowdfunding to restore a damaged mural after public grants failed to cover the full cost. (公部門補助不足以支付全額修復費後，博物館改以群眾募資修復受損壁畫。)

meaning: n. 群眾外包；大眾協作
example: Crowdsourcing helped the nonprofit map damaged roads faster than its small engineering team could manage alone. (群眾外包協助非營利組織更快標出受損道路，小型工程團隊單獨無法做到。)

meaning: adj. 具創業精神的；有進取心的
example: An enterprising land speculator purchased thousands of midwest prairie hectares, anticipating the transcontinental railway grid. (一位有進取心的土地投機者購買了數千公頃的中西部草原，預期橫貫大陸的鐵路網將會建成。)
Once the formalities were complete, the two firms transferred the assets and began joint operations. (形式手續完成後，兩家公司移轉資產並開始共同營運。)
Before expanding overseas, the company reviewed market fundamentals, cash flow, and its supply contracts. (拓展海外市場前，公司重新檢視市場基本面、現金流和供應合約。)

meaning: n. 地緣政治；地理政治
example: Energy geopolitics shifted after the pipeline opened, giving smaller states new bargaining power with larger neighbours. (管線啟用後，能源地緣政治出現變化，小國因此取得與大國談判的新籌碼。)
A grassroots coalition persuaded the council to publish neighborhood-level data on pollution exposure. (草根聯盟說服議會公布各社區層級的污染暴露資料。)

meaning: n. 衡量指標；度量標準
example: The agency adopted metrics to evaluate whether contractors delivered services on time and within budget. (機關採用新指標，評估承包商是否準時且在預算內提供服務。)

meaning: adj. 多面向的；多才多藝的
example: The evolutionary transition to bipedal locomotion freed early hominid forelimbs to manipulate tools with multifaceted designs. (演化出雙足行走後，早期人族解放了前肢，得以操作具有多種功能的工具。)
The journal prefers evidence-based analysis to polemics that caricature opponents and simplify difficult policy choices. (期刊偏好以證據為本的分析，而非醜化對手、簡化艱難政策選擇的論戰文字。)
The regulator warned consumers that the supplement's health claims rested on pseudoscience rather than controlled trials. (主管機關提醒消費者，這款補充品的健康宣稱依據的是偽科學，而非對照試驗。)
Regional realty prices softened after employers announced plans to relocate their headquarters. (雇主宣布遷移總部的計畫後，區域房地產價格開始走弱。)
Public scepticism persisted because officials released the findings without the underlying data or methodology. (官員公布結果時沒有提供原始資料或方法，因此民眾持續抱持懷疑。)
